initiatives.name: Low-Carbon Ventolin MDI Development and Launch
initiatives.summary: GSK achieved positive pivotal phase III results for a next-generation low-carbon version of Ventolin that can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 92% per inhaler. Teams across manufacturing sites are preparing for launch from 2026, with this addressing 43% of GSK's total carbon footprint.

evidence.title: Low-carbon Ventolin MDI development and launch preparation
evidence.summary: GSK achieved positive pivotal phase III results for a next-generation low-carbon version of Ventolin that can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 92% per inhaler. Teams across manufacturing sites are preparing for launch from 2026, with this addressing 43% of GSK's total carbon footprint.
evidence.quote: We have announced positive pivotal phase III data for a next-generation low-carbon version of Ventolin MDI, and these findings will support regulatory submissions. If approved, this version has the potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 92% per inhaler, with launch expected from 2026.

evidence.title: Carbon Emissions Reduction Targets by 2030/2045
evidence.summary: GSK has set ambitious targets to reduce carbon emissions by 80% by 2030 and 90% by 2045, both from a 2020 baseline. The company's ability to meet these targets depends on successful regulatory outcomes from their programme to redevelop the Ventolin inhaler using a lower-carbon propellant.
evidence.quote: Our ability to meet our targets of reducing carbon emissions by 80% and 90% by 2030 and 2045 (in each case, from a 2020 baseline), respectively, is based on successful regulatory outcomes from the programme to redevelop our Ventolin inhaler using a lower-carbon propellant.

initiatives.name: Science-Based Net Zero Climate Targets
initiatives.summary: GSK has set science-based targets to reduce carbon emissions by 80% by 2030 and achieve net zero by 2045 with at least 90% reduction. In 2025, they reduced Scope 1 & 2 emissions by 14% and achieved 100% renewable imported electricity target.

evidence.title: Science-based net zero climate targets with 80% emissions reduction
evidence.summary: GSK has set science-based targets to reduce carbon emissions by 80% by 2030 and achieve net zero by 2045 with at least 90% reduction. In 2025, they reduced Scope 1 & 2 emissions by 14% and achieved 100% renewable imported electricity target.
evidence.quote: By 2030, we aim to reduce carbon emissions by 80%, measured against a 2020 baseline, with the remainder covered through investment in high-quality nature-based solutions. By 2045, we aim to be at the Science Based Target initiative Net Zero Standard, with carbon emissions reduced by at least 90%

initiatives.name: GiGi AI-Powered Digital Assistant Deployment
initiatives.summary: GSK has implemented AI agents across the company including GiGi, an AI-powered digital assistant used by over 50,000 people monthly. AI applications are delivering benefits in production optimization, predictive maintenance, and quality investigations across over 20 manufacturing sites.

evidence.title: AI deployment across R&D and operations at scale
evidence.summary: GSK has implemented AI agents across the company including GiGi, an AI-powered digital assistant used by over 50,000 people monthly. AI applications are delivering benefits in production optimization, predictive maintenance, and quality investigations across over 20 manufacturing sites.
evidence.quote: We now have several AI agents across GSK; and GiGi, an AI-powered digital assistant for everyone, that helps people manage day-to-day tasks. More than 50,000 people across GSK use GiGi monthly.

initiatives.name: CEO Succession and Leadership Restructuring
initiatives.summary: Luke Miels was appointed as CEO and joined the Board on 1 January 2026, succeeding Emma Walmsley who stepped down at the end of December 2025. Luke was previously Chief Commercial Officer and brings extensive global biopharma pipeline development and commercialization experience.

evidence.title: CEO succession: Luke Miels appointed as new CEO
evidence.summary: Luke Miels was appointed as CEO and joined the Board on 1 January 2026, succeeding Emma Walmsley who stepped down at the end of December 2025. Luke was previously Chief Commercial Officer and brings extensive global biopharma pipeline development and commercialization experience.
evidence.quote: Having led an extensive transformation of GSK, Emma Walmsley stepped down as CEO at the end of December and handed over to Luke Miels, previously our Chief Commercial Officer.

evidence.title: Executive Committee expansion and operational governance evolution
evidence.summary: The CEO expanded the GSK Leadership Team (GLT) membership and renamed it the Executive Committee (ExCom) to provide greater strategic product insight and operational focus. New appointees include regional presidents and specialized roles to support next phase of growth.
evidence.quote: To support delivery of the CEO's key priorities the CEO has expanded the GLT membership to provide greater strategic product insight and operational focus. The Committee was also renamed the Executive Committee (the ExCom). This change took effect from January 2026.

initiatives.name: Rockville Manufacturing Facility Divestment to Samsung Biologics
initiatives.summary: GSK entered into a definitive agreement to sell 100% of its equity investment in Human Genome Sciences, principally including the Rockville manufacturing site, to Samsung Biologics. The facility has been classified as held for sale at £300 million.

evidence.title: Sale of Rockville manufacturing facility to Samsung Biologics
evidence.summary: GSK entered into a definitive agreement to sell 100% of its equity investment in Human Genome Sciences, principally including the Rockville manufacturing site, to Samsung Biologics. The facility has been classified as held for sale at £300 million.
evidence.quote: On 22 December 2025, GSK entered into a definitive agreement with Samsung Biologics for the sale of 100% of its equity investment in Human Genome Sciences, principally including the Rockville site, with closing anticipated towards the end of Q1 2026.

initiatives.name: Hengrui Pharma COPD Treatment Partnership
initiatives.summary: GSK agreed to develop a potential best-in-class PDE3/4 inhibitor in clinical development for COPD treatment with Hengrui Pharma. The deal includes agreements for an additional 11 programmes across respiratory, immunology and inflammation as well as oncology.

evidence.title: Strategic development deal with Hengrui Pharma for COPD treatment
evidence.summary: GSK agreed to develop a potential best-in-class PDE3/4 inhibitor in clinical development for COPD treatment with Hengrui Pharma. The deal includes agreements for an additional 11 programmes across respiratory, immunology and inflammation as well as oncology.
evidence.quote: Agreed to develop potential best-in-class PDE3/4 inhibitor in clinical development for the treatment of COPD, with Hengrui Pharma. The transaction also included agreements for an additional 11 programmes to be developed by Hengrui Pharma and optioned by GSK following phase I completion, across RI&I as well as Oncology

initiatives.name: Efimosfermin Alfa Acquisition from Boston Pharmaceuticals
initiatives.summary: GSK acquired efimosfermin alfa, an investigational specialty medicine aimed at treating and preventing steatotic liver disease (MASH). This acquisition strengthens GSK's pipeline in the respiratory, immunology and inflammation therapeutic area.

evidence.title: Acquisition of efimosfermin alfa from Boston Pharmaceuticals
evidence.summary: GSK acquired efimosfermin alfa, an investigational specialty medicine aimed at treating and preventing steatotic liver disease (MASH). This acquisition strengthens GSK's pipeline in the respiratory, immunology and inflammation therapeutic area.
evidence.quote: Acquisition of efimosfermin alfa from Boston Pharmaceuticals, an investigational specialty medicine aimed at treating and preventing steatotic liver disease

initiatives.name: Smart Manufacturing AI and Digital Transformation
initiatives.summary: GSK is investing in smart manufacturing that uses AI and digital technologies to transform product development and manufacturing. The programme aims to improve first-time quality, reduce deviations, ensure compliance, and enable faster portfolio delivery by predicting issues before they arise.

evidence.title: Smart manufacturing programme with AI and digital technologies
evidence.summary: GSK is investing in smart manufacturing that uses AI and digital technologies to transform product development and manufacturing. The programme aims to improve first-time quality, reduce deviations, ensure compliance, and enable faster portfolio delivery by predicting issues before they arise.
evidence.quote: We are also investing in our facilities to stay ahead of regulatory requirements, utilising AI and digital technologies to transform our approach to product development and manufacturing, allowing us to predict issues before they arise. This includes our smart manufacturing programme, which aims to improve first-time quality, reduce deviations, and ensure compliance, ultimately enabling faster delivery of our portfolio and pipeline.

initiatives.name: Cyber Security Framework Implementation
initiatives.summary: GSK is implementing comprehensive cyber security measures using external frameworks such as NIST Cyber Security Framework and ISO 27001/27002 standards. The company has established a dedicated Cyber Security Office led by a Chief Information Security Officer to manage enterprise-wide cyber security risks and controls.

evidence.title: Cyber Security Framework Implementation and Enhancement
evidence.summary: GSK is implementing comprehensive cyber security measures using external frameworks such as NIST Cyber Security Framework and ISO 27001/27002 standards. The company has established a dedicated Cyber Security Office led by a Chief Information Security Officer to manage enterprise-wide cyber security risks and controls.
evidence.quote: As our threat environment evolves, we also use external frameworks such as the NIST Cyber Security Framework to measure cyber security readiness and maturity and ISO 27001/27002 for general information technology controls.

initiatives.name: Advanced Technologies for Pipeline Innovation
initiatives.summary: GSK is driving enhanced pipeline innovation, performance and productivity through advanced technologies including digital tools, data analytics, AI/ML and cloud computing. This digital transformation requires continuous improvement in cyber security measures and defences to support these technological capabilities.

evidence.title: Advanced Technologies for Pipeline Innovation Enhancement
evidence.summary: GSK is driving enhanced pipeline innovation, performance and productivity through advanced technologies including digital tools, data analytics, AI/ML and cloud computing. This digital transformation requires continuous improvement in cyber security measures and defences to support these technological capabilities.
evidence.quote: Our drive to enhance pipeline innovation, performance and productivity through advanced technologies like digital tools, data analytics, AI/ML and cloud computing demands continuous improvement in our cyber security measures and defences.

initiatives.name: US R&D and Manufacturing Investment Programme
initiatives.summary: The Board approved a multi-year investment programme to expand R&D, clinical development and advanced biopharma manufacturing capabilities in the US. The decision was made in context of long-term growth, strategic pipeline needs and global supply chain resilience.

evidence.title: Multi-year US investment programme for R&D and manufacturing
evidence.summary: The Board approved a multi-year investment programme to expand R&D, clinical development and advanced biopharma manufacturing capabilities in the US. The decision was made in context of long-term growth, strategic pipeline needs and global supply chain resilience.
evidence.quote: The Board reviewed and approved a multi-year investment programme committing to expand R&D, clinical development and advanced biopharma manufacturing capabilities in the US.
